== Notes ==
* In the case of attacks which strike more than one foe, only the [[target]] will have the damage and deep wound applied.
* A character affected by this shout successfully hitting with [[Agonizing Chop]] will interrupt the target, which suggest that Deep Wound is applied first.
* Heroes use this skill on party members wielding a sword, axe, hammer, daggers, scythe, spear or shortbow, with an attribute level of at least 1 in the corresponding weapon mastery.
** Attribute bonuses, such as runes, are taken into account.
** [[Anniversary weapon]]s are treated as though they have a regular attribute requirement.
{{bug|The exact description should be "the next time target ally successfully hits with an attack", as this skill will not be removed and its effects won't be applied if the next attack [[miss]]es (due to [[blind]]), is [[block]]ed or if there is no [[line of sight]].}}
